releaseNotes: Local-first AI troubleshooting for install failures, a project Guide and reviewed file-repair proposals. Optional one-frame screen analysis uses a separate local vision model. macOS and Linux have working source ZIP downloads; local AI models are supported on Windows x64.

windows.label: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
windows.requirement: 450 MB free disk. Node.js, Git and Python are optional but unlock more stacks.

macos.label: macOS (Intel and Apple silicon)
macos.requirement: Source ZIP requires Node.js 24 or newer and Git. Native DMG is published when available.

linux.label: Linux (x86_64)
linux.requirement: Source ZIP requires Node.js 24 or newer and Git. AppImage is published when available.
